issue.title: Overhaul bash completion to mirror invoke logic

repository.name: click
repository.description: Python composable command line interface toolkit

issue.body:
Overhaul the bash completion code to mirror the invoke logic in core.py. Removed flawed assumption about handling of arguments with required=false in chained scenarios. Now completion search will halt on the first incomplete argument as the parser would.

More test case suggestions are welcome.

Fixes #925 
Fixes #919
